name: Agent Builder Starter Clone Kit 🧩
description_md:
# What You Get

- Visual Workflow Builder Spec: full-stack architecture, six-node canvas (Start/Agent/Tool/Router/Transform/End), OpenAI Responses API integration (GPT-4.1 + GPT-5 with reasoning + max_output_tokens), cURL-to-Tool import, variable substitution, Google Sheets logging, GitHub auto-commit, UI/UX fixes, and versioned workflow storage.

- Vibe Coding Mistakes Cheatsheet: 25 real pitfalls and fixes (wrong endpoint vs Responses API, missing reasoning + low tokens on GPT-5, Select value vs defaultValue, clipboard/paste UX, shortcut traps, safe spawn over exec, robust cURL parsing, debounced autosave).

- A battle-tested reverse meta-prompt to spin up a React Flow canvas + Replit Agent connectors, with export/importable workflow JSON and status badges baked in

- If you want the full codebase, join the Early AI-dopters Community — you won’t regret it 😉 
https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
